Coverage: Federal (IRS Pub 15-T Percentage Method + FICA/FUTA) + All 50 U.S. States + District of Columbia (51 jurisdictions) for Tax Years 2026 and 2027
Sources: IRS Rev. Proc. 2026-35 (Official 2027 Federal Income Tax Brackets & Standard Deductions)
IRS Publication 15-T Section 1 Percentage Method Tables for Automated Payroll Systems
Social Security Administration (SSA) Official OASDI Taxable Wage Base: $184,500 (2026) / $192,300 (2027)
Tax Foundation & State Departments of Revenue (2026 & enacted 2027 state rates, brackets, SUTA wage bases, and SDI/PFML programs)
DataStatusNote: 2027 Federal brackets, standard deductions, SSA wage base ($192,300), enacted 2027 state rate changes (HI, IN, MS, MT, NE, NC, NY, RI), major 2027 SDI/PFML rates/caps (CA, CO, CT, DE, MA, ME, MN, NJ, NY, OR, WA), and official 2027 SUTA wage bases are included. States that publish annual CPI bracket indexing or SUTA wage bases in late Q4/Q1 carry forward verified 2026 baselines as noted in each state Notes field.
